module: Tests of the protected navigation lock (options.cancellable == false) of router.lua: acquisition, blocking at admission, retention between commit and mount, and release on all terminal paths (cancel, rejection, failure, timeout, reset, deserialization). File run by the test framework, not an API for modders.
notes: The terminal path tests build a transition whose session carries a protection token and use the access points __test_getProtectionToken/__test_setProtectionToken of ui_router; the acquisition tests use a temporary mod route ("navprotect") cancelled before commit.

testDefaultNavigationsDoNotAcquireProtec.desc: cancellable nil or true: no lock, the last navigation wins.

testProtectedNavigationAcquiresBlocksAnd.desc: cancellable=false acquires the lock, blocks following navigations; cancel releases it.

testProtectedLockBlocksBeforeResolution.desc: The admission gate rejects a newer request before route resolution or guards.

testProtectedLockBlocksIdenticalAndRepea.desc: Repeated or identical requests are all blocked during protection (no queue).

testIdleRouterDoesNotBlockNavigation.desc: Without an active protected navigation, navigate is not blocked at admission.

testReleaseOfNonMatchingTokenPreservesLo.desc: Cleanup of an old transition cannot clear the lock of a newer protected navigation.

testTimeoutReleasesProtection.desc: A transition timeout releases the lock.

testDeserializeClearsStaleProtection.desc: onDeserialize drops a stale lock without touching the persistent navigation state.

testProtectionHeldAcrossCommitAndRelease.desc: The lock is kept between commit and mount, then released at full completion.

testProtectionReleasedOnNonMountCompleti.desc: A route without a mount acknowledgment releases the lock at routeChangeComplete.

testReloadForwardsCancellableFalse.desc: reload passes cancellable=false to the replayed transition, which acquires the lock.
